scientific.integrity: The proof starts from Tafazolian's explicit normal forms and normalizer-stabilizer identification, then performs a uniform two-dimensional linear-algebra calculation. The exceptional stabilizer is identified with the norm-one subgroup of the quadratic finite-field extension, so no finite experiment or unproved classification is used.
limitations: The result computes the normalizer of the distinguished Sylow p-subgroup, not the full automorphism group in every family member.
The symmetry-jump criterion is stated only for the two normal forms in Tafazolian's first admissible layer.
Absolute novelty is not established by database search; an elementary consequence of the source's stabilizer formula may exist in unindexed material.

title: Exact normalizer strata in Tafazolian's first-layer Artin--Schreier families
